author: HillaryClinton
text:
There’s plenty to feel discouraged about right now. But giving in to doom and gloom isn’t going to get us anywhere. 

That’s what CGI is about this week: bringing people together to talk about the future we want and how to fight for it. Join us: https://clintonglobal.org/2026
